ra: Zeus Labraundos of Labranda is a core deity of the Carian civic pantheon (Laumonier 1958).
Zeus Osogo/Zenoposeidon of Mylasa belongs to the Carian pantheon (Laumonier 1958).
Zeus Panamaros/Stratios of the Panamara sanctuary belongs to the Carian pantheon (Laumonier 1958).
Hecate of Lagina is the leading goddess of the Carian civic pantheon (Laumonier 1958).
The god of the Sinuri sanctuary is an indigenous member of the Carian pantheon (Laumonier 1958).
Zeus Labraundos is the Carian cult-form/local epithet of Zeus, the indigenous double-axe god interpreted as Zeus at Labranda.
Zeus Osogo of Mylasa is a Carian cult-form of Zeus (the indigenous god worshipped under the name Zeus Osogo).
Zeus Panamaros/Stratios is the Carian cult-form of Zeus at the Panamara sanctuary.
Hecate of Lagina is the great Carian cult-form of the Greek Hecate, the indigenous goddess venerated as Hecate at Lagina.
Zeus Osogo bore the title Zenoposeidon and combined attributes (trident with eagle, saltwater spring) of Poseidon, an ancient interpretatio fusing Zeus and Poseidon.
